summary: KT Corp filed a Form 6-K containing its 1Q26 earnings release. The document reports operating revenue of KRW 6,778.4bn (down 1.0% YoY), operating profit of KRW 482.7bn (down 29.9% YoY), and net income of KRW 388.3bn (down 31.5% YoY). It outlines a 2026-2028 shareholder return policy targeting 50% of adjusted net income via dividends and buybacks, and a 2026 guidance of minimum KRW 2,400 per share. This is a routine periodic financial report and does not involve a special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring.
